dataset.name: BANKING77 (12-intent adaptation)
dataset.selection: First 2 test rows per 12 selected intents, original text preserved; 12-way classification, not the official 77-way task.

cases.state: How do I locate my card?
cases.instructions: Classify the customer's banking intent into one of the provided categories.

choices.lost_or_stolen_card: Physical card is lost or stolen
choices.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM dispensed the wrong cash amount
choices.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for an ATM cash withdrawal
choices.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate on a card payment
